blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A “moderately strong” tremor was felt in Iloilo City on Friday morning following a Magnitude 4.3 earthquake south of Anilao town, according to state seismologists. The tectonic earthquake occurred on 5:11 a.m. four kilometers (km) south of Anilao town with a depth of 22 km, per the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs)
